ValidationRule.description: Pins allocate the reserve pool only: Expose_To Reserved, no live reservation. Public and MV-Reserved refuse. Fires only when the pin changes, so status writes on a pinned villa pass.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Pinned_Applicant__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Pinned_Applicant__c)), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Expose_To__c, "Reserved")), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Reserved")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Available")) ), NOT(ISBLANK(Active_Reservation__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only reserve-stock villas can be assigned: Expose To must be Reserved, the villa free of any live reservation. Public villas are for customers to book themselves.
